name: AI Advisor
tag: A self-hosted AI chat that remembers your projects and decisions so you don't repeat yourself.

scenarios.title: Pick up a project after a break
scenarios.ask: I haven't touched one of my {projects} projects in {weeks} weeks. Catch me up and tell me what's next.
steps: Memory search
Found the project in the vault among {projects} projects.
Recall
Pulled {=min(30, 4 + weeks)} saved notes, decisions and open questions.
Summarizer
Wrote a 5-line catch-up: goal, where you left off, last decision, blockers, next step.
Advisor
Suggested the next 3 actions and asked if anything changed while you were away.
followups: What does it save to memory?
Decisions, project facts and preferences you confirm. You can view, edit or delete any memory in the vault.
Can someone else see my memory?
It runs on your own server, so the vault stays with you. You choose who has an account.

scenarios.title: Recall why a decision was made
scenarios.ask: Why did we choose this tech stack {months} months ago? Show the reasoning and what has changed since.
steps: Memory search
Searched {chats} chats and found the original decision note.
Reasoning
Listed the 3 reasons recorded at the time and the options you ruled out.
Change check
Found {=max(1, round(chats / 80))} later chats that touch the same choice.
Advisor
Said whether the original reasons still hold, with links to each source chat.
followups: What if the memory is wrong?
Every memory links back to the chat it came from. If it is wrong, edit or delete it and the advisor uses the corrected version.
It suggests what to remember and you confirm. That keeps the vault clean and trustworthy.

scenarios.title: Estimate self-hosting costs
scenarios.ask: Run the advisor for {users} people sending about {msgs} messages a day each using a {model} model.
steps: Usage model
{=users * msgs} messages a day, about {=users * msgs * 22} a working month.
Cost model
Sample cost of about $0.01 per message for a hosted model, near zero for a local one.
Server sizing
Sized a small server for the app and memory vault: about $20 a month.
Advisor
Compared monthly totals for hosted and local options.
followups: A local model runs on your own hardware, so there is no per-message fee. You need a machine with enough memory, and answers may be slower.
Yes. The model is a setting. The memory vault stays the same either way.
